title: "Open folder with" context menu item for folders, like in Dolphin
line: Right-clicking a folder on the desktop, or in Dolphin's desktop:/ view, now offers "Open Folder With".
explanation: KFileItemActions::insertOpenWithActionsTo returns early for folders whose URL isn't a file:// URL, to keep "Open With" off remote folders. The desktop Folder View (and Dolphin on desktop:/) lists items with desktop:/ URLs, which are really local folders with a local path, so they never got "Open Folder With". The check now uses the item's local path instead of its URL scheme, as the service-menu code in the same file already does; the apps still receive the local file:// path, since the desktop worker sets it as the items' target URL.

commits.message:
KFileItemActions: offer Open Folder With for folders with a local path

Open With actions were skipped for every folder whose URL isn't file://,
so folders on desktop:/, seen in Dolphin or on the Plasma desktop, had no
"Open Folder With". Check the item's local path instead of its URL.

BUG: 451214

patches.diff:
From 4f8bc9d4ca6c50eecc653c33db009a2e2a39abf9 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 23:54:05 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] KFileItemActions: offer Open Folder With for folders with a
 local path

Open With actions were skipped for every folder whose URL isn't file://,
so folders on desktop:/, seen in Dolphin or on the Plasma desktop, had no
"Open Folder With". Check the item's local path instead of its URL.

BUG: 451214
---
 src/widgets/kfileitemactions.cpp | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/src/widgets/kfileitemactions.cpp b/src/widgets/kfileitemactions.cpp
index a9a61b72d..245bc35f6 100644
--- a/src/widgets/kfileitemactions.cpp
+++ b/src/widgets/kfileitemactions.cpp
@@ -762,7 +762,7 @@ void KFileItemActionsPrivate::insertOpenWithActionsTo(QAction *before, QMenu *to
     }
 
     const KFileItem &firstItem = items.first();
-    const bool isLocal = firstItem.url().isLocalFile();
+    const bool isLocal = !firstItem.localPath().isEmpty();
     const bool isDir = m_props.isDirectory();
     const int itemCount = items.count();
     // "Open With..." for folders is really not very useful, especially for remote folders.
-- 
2.53.0

review.text: Clean one-line fix in the right layer (KIO) using the exact same `!firstItem.localPath().isEmpty()` idiom already used by `addServiceActionsTo` in the same file. It fixes 'Open Folder With' for folders on the Plasma desktop (`desktop:/`), in Dolphin at `desktop:/`, and for other local-backed virtual protocols while keeping remote folders unaffected. Evidence, regression checks, and unit test results are thorough and honest about the minor `trash:/` note.

reviews.text: Clean one-line fix in the right layer (KIO) using the exact same `!firstItem.localPath().isEmpty()` idiom already used by `addServiceActionsTo` in the same file. It fixes 'Open Folder With' for folders on the Plasma desktop (`desktop:/`), in Dolphin at `desktop:/`, and for other local-backed virtual protocols while keeping remote folders unaffected. Evidence, regression checks, and unit test results are thorough and honest about the minor `trash:/` note.

Right root cause and layer: the folder check in KFileItemActions::insertOpenWithActionsTo used url().isLocalFile(), which excludes local-backed desktop:/ items, and switching to localPath() matches what the service-menu code in the same file already does. The fix also covers Dolphin on desktop:/ and Folder Views on desktop:/, and the evidence shows the entry on the desktop and a real launch with the local path. The comment right above the check still lists trash:/ as a remote dir that is skipped; trash items have a local path, so that comment is now stale. Ideally it gets updated (or trash excluded explicitly), and a kfileitemactionstest case for a desktop:/-style item with a local path would be nice; neither blocks the MR.
